name: PoolInstance
invariants: Total supply of aTokens == total deposits + accrued interest
Total variable debt == sum of all variable borrows + accrued interest
Health factor >= 1 for all non-liquidatable positions
Reserve liquidity == total deposits - total borrows
Utilization rate == total borrows / total deposits (0-100%)
Interest rate model: borrowRate >= supplyRate always
eMode LTV > normal LTV only for correlated assets
No negative balances after any operation
